tracking_numbers.name: GLS (12)
tracking_numbers.description: 12-digit parcel number: 11 digits and a check digit computed as GS1 mod 10 (weights 3 and 1 from the right) with 1 added to the sum. The +1 is expressed by always prepending a 1 at weight 1. Source of the algorithm: a single third-party description whose worked example agrees; medium confidence.

tracking_numbers.name: GLS (11)
tracking_numbers.description: 11-digit parcel number as GLS prints it in customer communication, without a check digit. Format only, so it needs context to be told apart from other 11-digit numbers.
